propositions: New blocking check p10_verification_presence requires leaf plans to have a Testing/Verification section, code-spanned AC items, or AC items matching verification vocabulary (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked, verif, exit code).
New blocking check p11_ac_vagueness detects vague language in AC items using fixed lexicon with word boundaries, excluding clean and exempting etc. within 30 characters after code spans.
P6 advisory ac_quality lexicon is updated to use the same fixed boundary-respecting matcher as p11 to maintain consistency across surfaces.
Code-span positions are recorded on original lines before blanking; vague lexicon matches inside recorded spans are suppressed.
Backtest over 153 tickets (104 passed, 55 blocked) showed p10 overlapped 4 marginal FPs with real blocking findings and p11 fixed lexicon produced 0 FPs across 304 passed plans.
